newsitem.title: USA: Accused N.Y. cannibal to remain in state care.
newsitem.headline: Accused N.Y. cannibal to remain in state care.

text.p: An accused cannibal, who allegedly castrated and ate the genitals of a teenage boy 17 years ago, was ordered on Wednesday to spend at least another two years in state psychiatric custody.

Albert Fentress, 55, of Poughkeepsie, N.Y., a former history and social studies teacher, was accused of killing Paul Masters, 17, in 1979 but found unfit to stand trial the following year by reason of insanity.

According to prosecutors, Fentress lured the youth to the basement of his home, where he tied him up, castrated him, cooked and ate his genitals, fell asleep and woke up to fatally shoot his victim out of his misery.
After three days of testimony this week, Suffolk County Court Judge John Vaughn ordered Fentress, who is diagnosed as schizophrenic, to remain in state care for the next two years.
Before the day's hearing, Fentress broke down in tears outside the Suffolk County courtroom.
After hearing the judge's decision, he said: "Of course I'm disappointed."
"We'll be back and not in a long time," he added.

Under state law, Fentress can petition for release every two years. He has been turned down several times previously in his efforts to be freed from the King Park Psychiatric Centre in New York, where he teaches fellow patients about computers.
"We've done our best to keep him there for 17 years and protect society," said Assistant State Attorney General John Stolfi, who called Fentress "a potential time bomb that can explode suddenly."
Fentress' lawyers wanted him released into the community under certain conditions, including court-mandated outpatient treatment and rehabilitation.
"What happened in 1979 was a monstrous act. There's no denying that," said Fentress' attorney Kim Darrow.

Fentress' attorneys have said he was driven to insanity after teenagers stole his stamp collection and threw eggs at his house. Fentress has testified that fear of his father caused him to murder Masters and once said his father had threatened to castrate him.
